finalText:
**Redis outage cascaded into a full crash.**

At `02:14:07` Redis dropped: `ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache fell back to direct store reads, causing cache-miss storms and 5s timeouts on every worker.

Reconnect attempts (7 through 12, every ~90s) all failed, same Redis host. Request queue depth climbed steadily from 52 to 568, way past the max of 500.

At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` from the backlog, restarted, then at `02:31:52` the `api` process went unresponsive and the supervisor killed the whole process group. Service down.

Root cause: Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` never came back, and nothing shed load or capped the queue while it was out.

Next: check why Redis died on that host and add a queue-depth circuit breaker so a future Redis outage degrades instead of OOMs.
